$comment: Fallback aspect-ratio choices offered by the config wizard when a gateway/model API does not advertise its own supported aspect ratios. 'decimal' is width/height.

ratios.label: DSLR / old TV
ratios.description: Classic 4:3 — DSLR stills and pre-HD television. The wizard default.

ratios.label: Modern TV / HD widescreen
ratios.description: Widescreen HD — modern TVs and most monitors.

ratios.label: Typical smartphone / laptop (landscape)
ratios.description: Common laptop and smartphone landscape ratio.

ratios.description: Tall phone-screen ratio used by recent iPhones (18:39 = 0.4615 ≈ 9:19.5).

ratios.label: Ultrawide / cinematic
ratios.description: Cinematic ultrawide — film and ultrawide monitors.

ratios.label: Univisium (2:1)
ratios.description: 2:1 — increasingly common for streaming and film.
